author: Hazzmanz
body: I was banned for an inappropriate name a few months ago. I have just found out that you can change your minecraft name so I changed it to something more appropriate, but am still banned! what should I do?
body_tagged: I was banned for an inappropriate name a few months ago. I have just found out that you can change your minecraft name so I changed it to something more appropriate, but am still banned! what should I do?
title: Banned!

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

I have appealed your infraction now that you have an appropriate name. You can now play on the server, and please ensure that you follow all the rules and guidelines. Have fun!

Regards,
Mango_
